newsitem.title: CHILE: Santa Isabel completes sale to Velox.
newsitem.headline: Santa Isabel completes sale to Velox.

text.p: Chilean supermarket chain Santa Isabel has completed the sale of 36.96 percent of its stock to Argentina's Velox International Investments, the company said.

A statement from the Valparaiso-based retailer said its founder and leading stockholder Eduardo Elberg had concluded negotiations with Velox, controlled by businessman Juan Peirano, and signed the contract for sale of 36.96 percent for $229.7 million.
Santa Isabel filed the statement with the Stocks and Securities Superintendency.
Elberg announced the deal to the news media on May 21, provoking a sharp rise in the price of Santa Isabel's local stock and its American Depositary Receipt.
Velox also controls Argentine supermarket chain Disco.
